formatContract.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ASCII metadata profile; RFC8785-compatible canonical form; no JSON numeric wire values
formatContract.nativeIDs: Nonzero exact lower-case 16-hex strings; never float/int coercion
formatContract.nullability: All fields required; suffix ? permits JSON null, not omission
formatContract.listSyntax: T[] means bounded array of defined T; no arbitrary maps
formatContract.operationDispatch: Only named operation and exact body/result field set; closed actor/evidence unions. Response.operation echoes Request.action.operation; outcome determines nullable result and decision consistency.
formatContract.nativeIDCodec: Unsigned 64-bit protobuf bit pattern rendered as zero-padded lower-case 16-hex big-endian text; a signed lease ID preserves its 64-bit bit pattern. Zero is not a live native identity/lease. Never float-convert.

primitives.B64_16: canonical unpadded base64url encoding exactly 16 bytes
primitives.B64_32: canonical unpadded base64url encoding exactly 32 bytes
primitives.B64_64: canonical unpadded base64url encoding exactly 64 bytes
primitives.B64_VAR: canonical unpadded base64url, nonempty, at most 16384 encoded characters; metadata total limit still applies
primitives.Q: decimal string 0..9223372036854775807, no leading zero except 0

atomicPredicates: Binary archive route only; CORE requires exact current coordinator and live reservation. uploadBundle.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: CORE reservation PREPARING/READY or live PurposePin with current committed owner context; receipt signature/key/current archive registration+generation; exact bundle/head/length/domain; no abort/commit reuse. Receipt cannot revive a terminal reservation.

For a live PurposePin, registered current receipts atomically mark PINNED once required independent copies exist; this never changes realm head or publishes a core. Resolved/released owner pins cannot be revived.
Already COMMITTED core reservation is never revived: use reattestCommitted for intact retained bytes. New candidate uploads require ACTIVE current archive generation.

atomicPredicates: Live exact reservation; two current ACTIVE independent archive generations and matching durable registered receipts; H/P/N/U/C unchanged. READY is not core commitment.
markReady.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: CORE purpose only. Exact READY version and pending pointer; original user operation+digest unresolved; H/P/N/U/C/scope current; archive registrations/generations+receipt versions unchanged; two current copies of published predecessor and candidate. Atomically H+COMMITTED user outcome+COMMITTED reservation+head/reference pins+audit; clear pending.

atomicPredicates: CORE purpose only. Exact live reservation/pending/outcome; candidate not committed; H not candidate. NODE must be current coordinator. GATEWAY maintenance may abort only atomically proven fenced/expired owner. Store terminal ABORTED original outcome + tombstone and clear pending.

atomicPredicates: Fresh accepted lineage and permitted caller/operation scope; exact target ID+digest. Missing decision is UNKNOWN, not proof the request cannot later execute. No secret result or fresh grant.

atomicPredicates: Committed terminal owner disposition, completed read or authority-expired reader lease and exact pin/reference versions; unresolved intent/backup owner prevents release. Core coordinator loss alone cannot release a PurposePin. Physical deletion still requires deletePermit.

atomicPredicates: Current committed/reference pin, verified surviving source, admitted target generation. Pin both ends and immutable digest; no H change or plaintext rights.
repairOpen.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Exact current repair ticket and target storage generation; copied/fsynced bytes bind committed bundle; required pins remain. Update current-copy evidence; REDUNDANT only after two independent valid copies. No H change.

Target may be admitted VERIFYING/REPAIRING while receiving bytes. A verified receipt becomes counted copy evidence only after activateArchive makes that exact generation ACTIVE. Existing ACTIVE target needs no new activation unless its generation/state changed.
repairRegister.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Terminal abort or committed retention transition; no current/pending/read/backup/external/recovery pins; two copies of still-required data preserved; exact reference-index+archive versions. Invalidate receipt and record irreversible deletion fence before physical unlink.
For a PurposePin, require RELEASED and its terminal committed owner disposition. reservationId names that pin; it is never treated as an aborted core reservation.
deletePermit.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Current enrolled archive/key and independent admission; exact former archive record; new generation on every archive restart. Atomically invalidate old receipts and set VERIFYING; same boot operation cannot allocate generation twice.

Verify HostAdmission under its exact domain/current guard authority and atomically consume its admissionId/counter bound to this boot operation and new generation. Old generation immediately stops counting; fresh reattestCommitted and activateArchive restore serving/copy evidence without H mutation.
archiveBoot.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Independently pinned current trust floor, admitted host/code, native cluster ID and fresh linearizable lineage agree; never restored cache/TOFU. No serving before success.
gatewayBoot.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Current H/P/N/U/C and exact plan/roles/scopes/hardware requirement; approved old identity fenced before new role activation; no new candidate self-approval.
replacementBegin.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Exact approved immutable plan/step ID; compare current native/application/archive/gateway records. Supported learner workflow; query outcome after timeout; halt if quorum/copy safety fails. New privileges/changed plan require new approval.
replacementStep.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Ordinary node credentials and boot current, exact original executor/intent/grant/token version/result pins. Evidence only. Revoked/retired node rejected on this route too. Current coordinator must publish via ordinary candidate protocol. No second provider request or generic replay.
intentCompleteSubmit.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Current enrolled archive signing key, admitted exact boot/storage generation in VERIFYING, REPAIRING or ACTIVE. Receipt reattestationId equals this action operationId; archive bindings match actor/current registration. QUARANTINED/REMOVED denied.

Fresh linearizable H and reference index prove exact immutable committed bundle/descriptor and a live retained current/read/backup/external/recovery reference. No terminal reservation is reopened; no surviving-source receipt is required.

Archive independently verifies every ciphertext byte/digest/length, manifest coverage and existing durable pin; reconstructs a missing local pin only from this live authority reference. Hold file/pin lock through fsync(file+pin+directories), signing and registration; no receipt for absent/corrupt/incomplete bytes.

Atomic CAS compares H, reference-index version/live reference, archive record+generation+key version and absence of deletion permit/fence for this physical bundle. Register new-generation copy evidence and durable action decision together. No H/plaintext/user-authority change. Active-copy health counts receipt only when archive is ACTIVE.

Reference/head/generation race rejects stale evidence. Re-read and fully reverify with a new operation after a terminal rejection; lost replies query/retry the same immutable ID/digest. Never revive old receipts or reuse an already deletion-fenced file.
reattestCommitted.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

atomicPredicates: Current admitted archive boot/generation/key, VERIFYING or REPAIRING; exact current H, reference index and registration. Recheck HostAdmission consumption/guard identity/current trust; no restart/restore drift during scan.

Complete protected-inventory scan at the exact reference index classifies every retained assigned local bundle exactly once as verified, missing or quarantined. Counts and canonical sorted descriptor-set digests match authoritative inventory/registered current-generation receipt records. Inventory is paginated under the same index, not embedded as an unbounded metadata list. Unknown or unscanned entries prohibit activation.

Atomically mark the exact registration ACTIVE and recompute availability from current-generation per-bundle evidence and failure domains. Missing/corrupt entries stay unavailable and enter repair; activation needs no second archive receipt and never asserts two-copy health by itself. No H change.

If H/reference index/registration changes, reject and reconcile/rescan before a new action; lost acknowledgement resolves by stable ID. Removal/quarantine or another boot fences old activation. Archive ACTIVE with zero valid copies is permitted only with honest UNAVAILABLE health and sensitive/core-write gates still closed.
activateArchive.idempotency: Stable action operationId + domain-separated actionDigest; fresh transport requestId/nonce. Same ID/different digest is rejected. Historical success is status only; current role predicates still apply to new authority.

signingRules.response: JCS(Response); WireResponse.keyId is pinned to response.serverId and accepted trust record before verification
signingRules.receiptAndOwner: JCS(record with exactly signature removed); every other required/known field retained
signingRules.errors: TransportError is not an authoritative decision; it never proves a timed-out original action could not commit.
signingRules.algorithm: Ed25519 detached signature; canonical unpadded base64url 64-byte signatures and 32-byte public keys; reject wrong algorithm/length/noncanonical JSON/unknown fields before semantic acceptance.
signingRules.hostAdmission: Ed25519(domains.hostAdmission UTF-8 bytes || ASCII-JCS(HostAdmission with exactly signature removed)); signer ID remains signed. Resolve hostGuardKeyId exclusively from independently retained guard authority pinned to this component/host and accepted trust floor; never from the admitted image. Verify all lineage/native-cluster/trust/component-kind/identity/volume/storage-generation/boot/operation bindings and restart class. admissionCounter is guard-monotonic outside component rollback scope. Atomically consume admissionId+digest+counter with exact boot registration decision; same ID+same digest returns history, same ID+different digest fails. Older counter/admission or a later boot/replacement/trust transition cannot regain serving. Voter startup guard durably consumes its locally pinned boot admission before launch; intact cold restart is not made circular on an unavailable quorum.
signingRules.recoveryManifest: Ed25519(domains.recoveryManifest UTF-8 bytes || ASCII-JCS(RecoveryTrustManifest with exactly signature removed)); recoveryKeyId is signed. Resolve key only from recovery authority pinned BEFORE disaster in independent trust floor; not from newTrustPack or manifest-supplied keys. Require exact oldTrustPackDigest=current accepted floor, next recoverySequence, same logical cluster/realm, fresh incarnation and native cluster ID, increasing trustRevision, authorized selected historical recovery head and all approved positive-fencing/revocation/data-loss/independent-approval evidence digests. Validate and retain the actual evidence, not only its hash. Selected old head remains provenance, not a current new-lineage authorization.
signingRules.archiveReattestation: Ed25519(domains.archiveReattestation UTF-8 bytes || ASCII-JCS(CommittedCopyReceipt with exactly signature removed)); current pinned archive key, boot/generation/reference and transaction checks apply. This domain cannot validate an ordinary candidate ArchiveReceipt or vice versa.
signingRules.recoveryConsumption: Recovery installer holds independent trust-state lock. Persist manifest+verified evidence+PREPARED old-floor/next-sequence intent, fsync; CAS accepted old floor to the exact new pack/sequence/recoveryId+digest and consumed record, fsync files/directories, then admit the new lineage. Crash before acknowledged durable transition remains locked and resumes the same intent. Same ID+digest only resolves that transition; no repeated rights reset, new lineage, sequence advance or unfencing. Older/different manifest, reused ID/different digest, or any replay after a newer floor is rejected. New host import requires independently authenticated recovery of the latest floor, never snapshot TOFU.
signingRules.responseConsistency: Response operation/requestId/nonce/actionDigest and accepted lineage are bound to the triggering request. REJECTED requires result=null and a durable exact original Decision(result=REJECTED, reason!=NONE, resultHeadDigest=null); no requested effect/grant/reservation may exist. SUCCESS requires exact typed non-null result and operation-appropriate successful decision or explicitly read-only null decision. Reason NONE for successful decisions. TransportError and quorum unavailability are not terminal decisions. ID_REUSE must never overwrite/relabel an earlier operation; return non-decision error or query its original digest.
signingRules.statusConsistency: Successful status has Response.operation=status and outcome=SUCCESS, with result.resolution=DECIDED plus exact targetDecision, or UNKNOWN plus targetDecision=null. A historical REJECTED target does not make the status query itself REJECTED. No grantRef or target success payload is returned/reissued by status. A rejected status query uses outcome=REJECTED/result=null for its own query action, not the target. Response.decision, if present, always belongs to triggering action; targetDecision only to named target.

unions.OperationResult: Exact operations[Response.operation].result on SUCCESS; JSON null on REJECTED. Dispatch requires Response.operation to equal the triggering Request.action.operation.

archiveBinaryRoute.authentication: Current enrolled uploader/mTLS identity; fresh quorum reservation/current archive generation; signed descriptors bind exact body digest+length. No success receipt before bytes+pin+directory durability.
archiveBinaryRoute.staging: Reservation-owned complete bundle file; no cross-reservation physical dedup in initial implementation.

Change nonce without resigning
Verify receipt under request domain

Substitute newer H after checking U
Local owner changes another scope/global policy
Present READY receipt after generation change
Delayed commit after terminal abort
Treat NOT_FOUND as final cancellation
Retired node submits completion online

Fresh nonce/certificate for unaccepted incarnation

HostAdmission verified under recovery domain or wrong pinned signer

responseDecisionContract.rejectionTransaction: Authenticated schema-valid action only; atomically compare exact ID/digest and unresolved original state, then persist terminal REJECTED plus audit. Concurrent execution/abort and rejection share original-outcome CAS. A preexisting success is historical status, never converted to rejection.
responseDecisionContract.readOnlyNullDecision: readHead/status SUCCESS use decision=null; typed result is informational and grants no requested effect. Other SUCCESS responses require durable matching decision.
responseDecisionContract.historicalReplay: Only status may return an older operation outcome. Never return an old grant/reference as a fresh successful authorize response when current checks fail.

archiveRecoveryContract.states: archiveBoot -> VERIFYING; scan and reattest existing retained bytes without source -> activateArchive -> ACTIVE. Missing data may enter REPAIRING and use repairOpen/repairRegister; reactivation uses the same exact-generation admission rules. QUARANTINED/REMOVED require separate approved disposition, never self-activation.
archiveRecoveryContract.independentRecovery: All three archives may restart and lose all old receipts. Healthy quorum plus intact admitted local bytes is sufficient to register first fresh receipts; no other archive current receipt is needed. Two ACTIVE independent verified copies restore REDUNDANT without new H.
archiveRecoveryContract.localPinRace: Before signing, exact physical file/pin is durably locked; deletion requires prior authority fence that reattestation CAS compares. Terminal reservation remains COMMITTED. Health is derived from receipt versions+active archive generation and never inventory labels alone.
archiveRecoveryContract.scanScope: For activation, scan every locally assigned retained protected bundle at the exact authority reference index, including current head and retained purpose/recovery references. The immutable sorted inventory supplies total coverage; missing/corrupt classification does not fabricate copy evidence. Reconcile changed index before activation.
archiveRecoveryContract.generationInvalidation: Every boot transaction changes the current registration/generation; all old evidence immediately becomes noncounting by generation equality even if old receipt records remain. Registration status and per-bundle health are separate predicates.

recoveryTrustContract.guardEnrollment: Host guard signer public key/component authorization retained outside restored machine, enrolled by existing eligible hardware/recovery policy. Rotation/removal needs approved trust transition; a new guard cannot self-admit from old VM credentials.
recoveryTrustContract.renewalAndRevocation: Normal key renewal authenticated by current approved trust transition; revoked guard/recovery signer cannot authorize new admission/recovery. Recovery-authority loss/rotation uses separately retained recovery access under declared independent procedure, never weaker browser fallback. Actual identities and tested procedures are blocking deployment inputs.
recoveryTrustContract.noUniquePhysicalSigner: Logical guard/recovery authority and protected private-key recovery copies exist in at least two independent accessible locations. Component keys remain scoped. No required key lives only on a failed coordinator/voter.
recoveryTrustContract.voterAdmission: Independently durable host guard validates pinned native member/cluster identity and intact volume evidence before native existing-cluster launch. Restored/unknown volumes use fenced clean replacement, not new signed authorization to reuse stale voter data.
